### [Listed and visible are different things](http://127.0.0.1:4000/host/not-in-search#listed-and-visible-are-different-things) — `MCL-86d19ded9c417bbf`

**Status:** UNVALIDATED

**Literal source text:** Separate "listed" from "visible in a normal broad search." Marketplace search is not a complete inventory dump. It limits result sets, ranks and groups similar offers, tries to avoid race conditions, and usually shows the best matches first. Search can be affected by ranking, grouping, filters, verification state, offer state, rental state, reliability, price, supply and demand, or machine errors.

## [Maintenance Windows](http://127.0.0.1:4000/host/maintenance-windows)

### [Introduction](http://127.0.0.1:4000/host/maintenance-windows) — `MCL-317e2353bba9ddc0`

**Status:** UNVALIDATED

**Literal source text:** Upgrade the metapackage, not a bare `linux-image-...` package. The metapackage depends on both the image and the matching headers, which is why `linux-headers-5.15.0-190-generic` appears above. DKMS needs headers matching the kernel it is building for, and the NVIDIA driver is built by DKMS. Install an image on its own and the driver has nothing to rebuild against, so the GPUs disappear on the next boot.

**Required proof:** Canonical Implementation Source, Runtime Or Ui Observation

The state `activating (auto-restart)` with a message like `Restart=on-failure` or `Scheduled restart job` also indicates a restart loop. In that case, inspect the logs (see the debugging commands below) to find the crash reason.
